name: Karavasta Lagoon (Divjaka-Karavasta National Park)
story: Karavasta Lagoon is the largest lagoon in Albania, spanning an area of 42 square kilometres. It is part of Divjaka-Karavasta National Park and is separated from the Adriatic Sea by a large strip of sand. The area hosts many pine trees, small sandy islands, and the Dalmatian pelican.
matters: The lagoon is recognized as a wetland of international importance under the Ramsar Convention. It is home to 6.4% of Europe's population of the Dalmatian pelican, serving as its only coastal breeding site along the Adriatic and Ionian Sea.
